name: Embedded controller cannot start
symptom: The board powers on, but firmware does not start and the debugger cannot connect.
observations: Power LED is on. Reset pin measures low. USB cable works with another device.
recent_changes: Changed the firmware target and rewired an external sensor.
constraints: Only low-voltage bench tests are allowed.

name: Motor stops under load
symptom: The motor starts normally but stops after two seconds when the load is attached.
observations: Driver fault LED turns on. Supply falls from 24 V to 20 V. Motor is warm.
constraints: Do not exceed 2 A. Guard must remain installed.
